known_art_issues: Existing painted highlights remain in the source images.
Light maps estimate broad surface illumination without per-pixel normals.
Night exterior is a graded version of the daylight landscape, not new night landscape art.
Static grouped furniture uses authored shadow proxies rather than recovered silhouettes.
Wizard has idle pose only; no walking, reaching, gripping or pouring poses.
Chest lid and armillary rings are still combined rasters.

effects.note: Upper flame-only crop; no floating logs. Flames rise from potion rim.

revision_notes: Added independently adjustable exterior light, warmth and sun height.
Added independent candle and hearth light controls and four lighting presets.
Added receiver-clipped contact and cast shadows, including dynamic teaware shadows.
Added shelf occlusion, rug-edge contact, and shared interior illumination.
Kept neutral rasters, shadows, light maps and environmental artwork separate.

compositing.furnishings.png: Exported from the exact same shelf/rug/static-prop/decor placement data as preview; alpha-only full-canvas static overlay. Interactive sprites and hearth effects excluded.
compositing.ordering: Use sorted runtime layers to support object/foreground depth. Flattened overlay is a convenience for static assembly.
compositing.projective_mapping: Bilinear mesh with 20x12 cells and 2 triangles per cell; source and target quads are stored in JSON.
compositing.lighting: Use lighting.render_pipeline; do not draw opaque RGB light maps directly over the exterior.

lighting.model: 2.5D image-based lighting, approximate diffuse light maps and alpha-silhouette shadow projection
lighting.color_pipeline: sRGB artistic compositing; not radiometrically calibrated

shadow_projection.contact_shadows: Soft receiver-clipped ellipses at explicit supports; independent of directional-light strength.
shadow_projection.dominant_key: Daylight when strong enough; otherwise hearth, then chandelier.
shadow_projection.held_objects: Contact darkening removed; tabletop shadow follows projected horizontal location, fades and softens with estimated lift.
shadow_projection.limitations: Authored 2.5D projection; no recovered depth map, normal map or 3D light transport.

render_pipeline: render outside with exposure and atmosphere
render room and neutral static layers into interior buffer
render floor contact/cast shadows above rug but below props
render local receiver shadows before props and teaware
render props, character, foreground furniture and effects
multiply shared illumination over interior buffer
restore original interior alpha to preserve outdoor openings

export_contract.lighting_maps: RGB gain maps for multiply, not opaque scene overlays. Restore interior alpha after multiplying.
export_contract.shadow_maps: Transparent black rasters, source-over on the indicated receiver at the indicated depth.
export_contract.neutral_assets: Art assets remain unchanged; existing source highlights are not removed.
export_contract.snapshot_states: Daylight, overcast, evening, night with wizard; daylight also without wizard. All snapshot maps use the default object arrangement.

limitations: Existing painted highlights remain in the source images.
Light maps estimate broad surface illumination without per-pixel normals.
Night exterior is a graded version of the daylight landscape, not new night landscape art.
Static grouped furniture uses authored shadow proxies rather than recovered silhouettes.

ambient_gain.note: RGB gain factors on 0..255 multiply scale, plus colored area-light fields.

lighting.minimum_ambient: At zero added daylight/candles/hearth, ambient_gain.base_rgb retains a small artistic readability fill. Edit this RGB term for total darkness.
